blocks.text: DAVAO CITY – The 67th Infantry Battalion (67IB) under the 10th Infantry “Agila” Division (10ID) completed the 10-day Battalion Evaluation and Certification Program (BECP) on Wednesday, earning the highest score among other units in Mindanao. The battalion’s performance further strengthened 10ID’s operational readiness in support of its Comprehensive Archipelagic Defense Operations (CADO). 67IB underwent a 10-day comprehensive assessment of its operational capabilities through different exercises, including live-fire drills, field training, and sustainment activities.
